necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91) and cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9), reporting persistent episodes of palpitations that interfere with daily activities. To further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, a 48-hour Holter monitor (CPT 93226) was ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording. This service is medically necessary to evaluate the clinical indication of palpitations and manage the diagnosed cardiac conditions.
